positions.name: SlugFromContentWhenNoId
positions.frame: how does the pipeline produce a file identifier when no explicit id is supplied?
positions.why: src-1 asserts the absence of an explicit id field, and src-2 directs that the pipeline must still produce a slug from memory content — via the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback — and commit the file. Together they cohere under the question of how identification proceeds when no id is given: the assertion of absence sets the condition, and the directive names the two fallback mechanisms that satisfy it.
